messages:
infra-bot: ALERT: dedicated-reserved-pool=blueleaf-prod reached 100% GPU utilization across zone-3; queue length rising (>120s median). autoscaler reported 'max_capacity_reached' and did not create new instances. ticket: INC-444321.
Aisha (oncall): ack — paging oncall. tagging eng-runtime + infra. starting initial triage.
Kai (infra): I'm on it. pulling pool state now.
Kai (infra): ```
# resvctl pool show blueleaf-prod --zone zone-3
utilization: 100%
queued_requests: 312
autoscaler_state: active
autoscaler_note: reached-global-max-capacity (limit=48 gpus)
leader_lease: stale
```
ben (sre): queue >300 and median latency 35s for blueleaf routes. are we evicting best-effort tenants?
Aisha (oncall): not yet; want to avoid collateral. whats cheapest quick win?
Natalie (eng-runtime): quick idea — reduce per-tenant max_sessions for non-reserved tenants in zone-3 to free up slots, and enable forced-eviction for best-effort. can push change w/ runbook step.
Kai (infra): autoscaler won't scale because global cap hit. we can either: 1) increase cap (requires infra-admin approval + quota), 2) drain/evict low priority sessions, or 3) burst to hosted nodes as fallback.
Aisha (oncall): call customer-ops. Customer Ops Bot, please open bridge with Blueleaf and notify SLA risk.
Customer Ops Bot: Bridge created: https://meet.bridge/blueleaf-444321 (joining). Notifying Blueleaf support contacts.
ben (sre): metrics: error_rate for blueleaf up from 0.2% -> 2.8% for generation endpoints. embeddings latency 5x. This is customer-visible.
Aisha (oncall): ok action plan: (A) perform targeted eviction of best-effort sessions in zone-3, (B) request temporary cap increase + enable burst capacity, (C) escalate to eng-runtime to debug leader_lease/staleness. Kai, can you start A? I'll kick off B with infra-admin. Natalie take C.
Kai (infra): doing A now — running eviction command for sessions tagged "best-effort" older than 8m. ```
# resvctl sessions evict --pool blueleaf-prod --zone zone-3 --filter "priority=best-effort and age>8m" --dry-run
would_evict: 86 sessions
```
Kai (infra): executing now. ```
# resvctl sessions evict --pool blueleaf-prod --zone zone-3 --filter "priority=best-effort and age>8m"
evicted: 86 sessions
queued_requests: 214
utilization: 94%
```
ben (sre): latency down to 22s median, still high but trending. queued_requests -> 214, good move.
Aisha (oncall): I'm pinging infra-admins for cap bump (urgent). @infra-admins please approve temporary +8 GPUs for zone-3 for 2 hours.
Kai (infra): infra-admin approved +6 GPUs, provisioning now. ```
# infractl capacity add --pool blueleaf-prod --zone zone-3 --gpus 6 --duration 120m
status: provisioning
```
Natalie (eng-runtime): investigating leader lease note. looks like autoscaler leader-agent lost lease when K8s API flapped earlier; leader election didn't recover properly, leaving a stale lock preventing new pods. reproducing locally. I can push a restart to leader pod to force re-election.
Aisha (oncall): go ahead Natalie. coordinate with Kai before restart.
Natalie (eng-runtime): restarting leader pod... ```
kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment/autoscaler-leader-blueleaf
```
infra-bot: ACTION_LOG: +6 GPUs provisioning started by infra-admin. eviction applied: 86 sessions. autoscaler restart initiated by Natalie.
ben (sre): provisioning finished, additional GPUs active. queued_requests: 38, median latency: 7.2s, error_rate back to 0.3%.
Aisha (oncall): nice. Customer Ops Bot — update Blueleaf: we've applied mitigation (evicted low-priority jobs, added temporary capacity, restarted autoscaler). We expect normal service within minutes.
Customer Ops Bot: Blueleaf notified. Response: "Thanks—we see improvements on our side, please keep us posted."
Kai (infra): note: autoscaler leader restarted and re-acquired lease; root cause trace points to leader-election bug when API server returned 500 responses during a control-plane incident earlier today. filing issue ENG-RH-3456.
Natalie (eng-runtime): creating PR for fix + improved healthchecks; will include telemetry to detect stale leader leases and auto-restart after ttl.
Aisha (oncall): post-incident tasks: 1) Postmortem with timeline and customer impact, 2) runbook update for forced-eviction thresholds, 3) capacity policy review to avoid single-pool global cap causing customer impact, 4) notify sales/CS to offer credit if SLA breach. Assigning owners: ben -> postmortem draft, Kai -> capacity policy, Natalie -> code fix/PR, Aisha -> customer comms.
ben (sre): drafting postmortem now, will include graphs + command outputs. ETA 2 hours for draft.
Aisha (oncall): handing off to Kai for follow-up; I'm available if Blueleaf needs more. closing live bridge at 4443211299 after stabilization. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
